title: Siri ruins the voice experience
body:
Good features, but Siri ruins the voice experience ★★☆☆☆
Reminders is great for lists, tags, and smart scheduling—but its voice capture is let down by Siri’s poor recognition of non-American and non-native English accents. That’s a huge miss when over 75% of English speakers worldwide are non-native, and most iPhone users live outside an english-native region such as US/ europe. Google Assistant and GPT-powered apps handle accents far better. Apple needs to make accent-robust, global-ready speech recognition a top priority—because hands-free reminders should work for everyone, not just those with a native englisg accent.

title: Awesome
body: Apple's Notes app is an indispensable tool for anyone with an Apple device. Its seamless integration across iPhone, iPad, and Mac makes it effortlessly convenient for jotting down ideas, creating to-do lists, or even drafting entire documents. The clean interface and intuitive design make organizing notes a breeze, while features like checklists, formatting options, and the ability to add images and sketches enhance productivity and creativity. With iCloud syncing, your notes are always up to date across all your devices, ensuring you never miss a beat. Plus, with robust security measures in place, you can trust that your personal information remains safe. Whether you're a student, professional, or just someone who loves to stay organized, Apple's Notes app is a must-have for streamlining your digital life.
